description: Use before writing or fixing packetdiag packet/bit-field diagrams for render_diagram (format packetdiag): rules checked against the renderer, worked examples, identifier rule.
identifier: packetdiag fields are positional (`0-15: Label;`) and have no key, so there is no place for an identifier; the label text is the only name, so put the human-readable name there (optionally prefixed: `0-15: n0002 engine;`). Never invent identifiers.

single-bit flags
